summary: The fund invests in option contracts, specifically FLEX Options, to pursue its investment objective and seek to provide the Outcomes. The reference asset for all of the fund’s FLEX Options is the Underlying ETF. The SPDR® S&P 500® ETF Trust is an exchange traded unit investment trust that seeks to provide investment results that, before expenses, correspond generally to the price and yield performance of the S&P 500® Index. It is non-diversified.
